feeds.title: Connect Ability Blog
feeds.description: Connect ability Australia was founded in 1992 by a group of community members and families to meet the needs of people with significant disabilities to provide opportunities to access community based resources, aged care support, facilities, disability support and family counselling. They look at creating meaningful relationships and true inclusion for people within the community. It can work with you to address any barriers that exist for you being able to achieve your goals, dreams and aspirations. Go through their blog to know more about services, support, tips, articles, latest news, etc.

feeds.title: OSAN Ability Blog
feeds.description: OSAN ABILITY is an NDIS-registered (National Disability Insurance Scheme) Provider based in Sydney specializing in Disability Support, Disability Accommodation (SDA, Short Term, Medium Term), Community Participation, Domestic Assistance, Allied Health, and In-Home Aged Care. Read the latest Updates, News, and Announcements on NDIS, Aged Care, and Disability Services.

feeds.title: Advance Disability Services & Respite Blog
feeds.description: We're a registered NDIS provider with a committed team of professionals passionate about delivering high-quality support and services to people aged 17-65 living with disabilities. At Advance Disability Services & Respite, we believe in giving everyone the best chance to live independently and follow their dreams. That's why we offer a range of disability supports and services designed to suit your individual needs.

feeds.title: Link Magazine
feeds.description: LINK Magazine is a national publication that covers a diverse range of topics around Australia including news, issues, art, sport, breakthroughs, travel, health, advocacy, products, and people in the disability sector. Its mission is to publish a quality Australian magazine that offers real opinions and perspectives directly from people with disability.

feeds.title: Have Wheelchair Will Travel Blog
feeds.description: At Have Wheelchair Will Travel, this family shares their travel adventures, tips, and day-to-day experiences. Recognizing travel as an occasional indulgence, they offer insights and fun tidbits beyond travel, catering to a diverse audience seeking inspiration and practical advice.

feeds.title: Physical Disability Australia Blog
feeds.description: Physical Disability Australia is a national peak Disability Peoples Organisation (DPO) run by people with physical disability for people with physical disabilities. We are enabling every Australian living with a physical disability to realize their full potential.

feeds.title: Blue Badge Insurance Australia Blog
feeds.description: At Blue Badge Insurance we understand how important your freedom and independence are. This is why we've tailored our comprehensive car and disability equipment insurance to protect the things that keep you moving. Get mobility tips, news, and broader views for people living with disability plus info about mobility insurance.

feeds.title: People With Disability Australia News
feeds.description: People with Disability Australia (PWDA) is a national peak disability rights and advocacy organization made up of and led by people with disability. Our vision is of a socially just, accessible, and inclusive community, in which the human rights, citizenship, contribution, potential, and diversity of all people with disability are respected and celebrated.

feeds.title: Women With Disabilities Australia Blog
feeds.description: Find writings, videos, and podcasts from women with disabilities. Women With Disabilities Australia is run by and for women, girls, feminine identifying, and non-binary people with disabilities across Australia. We work to promote, educate and improve the human rights of women and girls with disability.

feeds.title: Carly Findlay
feeds.description: Carly Findlay OAM is an award-winning writer, speaker, and appearance activist. She presents on disability and appearance diversity topics including access and inclusion training, disability training for the media, and also keynote speeches based on her own lived experience, plus workshops on social media, writing online, disability in literature, and memoir.

feeds.title: Hands On People Blog
feeds.description: We at Hands On People are an Official NDIS provider who specializes in supporting Territorians living with a disability to lead the life they want. We encourage people with disability and older persons to become independent so they can connect with their community. Hands-On People Blog provides relevant news and updates.

feeds.title: Sunnyfield Disability Services
feeds.description: Read all the latest in NDIS, disability, and Sunnyfield news. Since 1952, Sunnyfield has been enriching the lives of people with disability by creating choices, opportunities, and skills for life. Working together with families, friends, and dedicated staff, Sunnyfield supports a brighter future for people with disability.

feeds.title: Australia Disability Services Blog
feeds.description: At Australia Disability Services, we empower individuals by teaching and counseling how they can learn, take their education, and become a better part of society. Everyone can handle physical and mental health better after some time with Australia Disability Services. Get insights on everything related to disability care.

feeds.title: Shine Social And Communities
feeds.description: At Shine Social And Communities, our mission is to assist individuals to achieve a better quality of life. We advocate for choice, by empowering, supporting, and enabling people to achieve their goals. We provide programs and services which are person-centred, holistic and solution-focused.

feeds.title: Care Aide Disability Support Blog
feeds.description: Explore our NDIS blog to know more about Disability & Home Care Services, as well as several crucial Must-know facts, news, and other important updates. We are a recognized & experienced NDIS provider in the Melbourne region, committed to empowering individuals with a disability to get the most out of their life.

feeds.title: Integrity Disability Hub Blog
feeds.description: Read the latest news and advice from our team of experts, including NDIS information for people with disabilities. At Integrity Disability, we are your specialists in the NDIS. Our team of Disability Support Workers and NDIS Plan Managers is passionately driven to assist people living with disabilities in reaching their objectives and improving their quality of life.

feeds.title: Disability Gateway News
feeds.description: Get news and updates from the Disability Gateway. The Disability Gateway is an Australian Government initiative for all people with disability. The Disability Gateway assists all people with disability, their families, and carers to locate and access services across Australia.

feeds.title: Source Kids Blog
feeds.description: Source Kids is Australia's first magazine for parents, carers, families, professionals and teachers working with children with special needs. It delivers the latest information on a range of topics that touch the lives of children with disabilities and their families and carers.

feeds.title: Empowered Community Services Blog
feeds.description: Empowered Community Services delivers high-quality, individualized support under the NDIS that helps people with a disability build capacity and independence whilst ensuring they have every opportunity to participate in their community. Get relevant news and updates.
